congress.note: Per-frame counts count vehicles VISIBLE in that frame per the human review. A vehicle seen in 6 frames (e.g. V10) is counted once in the totals but appears in each frame it is visible in. The model is scored per-frame against ground_truth_count, and on the 15-vehicle total across the set. 14/15 vehicles are unclassified by the human — the model cannot beat that on movement; score movement only on V-through (the 1 classified through) and count accuracy on the rest.

military.note: No hand count exists for this set. Score descriptively only: per-frame vehicle count + conditions, to be compared against a hand count done at run time. Do NOT present Military counts as validated.
